'''Aelgar''' was one of the [[Ten Nations]] and fell in the aftermath of the [[Trolloc Wars]]. It was renowned for its wealth and power.{{verify}} The associated denonym is '''Aelgari'''.{{ref/book|5|22}}

==Geography==
[[Image:Aelgar.png|thumb|200px|left|In red location within the Ten Nations]]

Aelgar was located in the southwestern corner of the [[Westlands]], stretching from the [[Aryth Ocean]] to the [[River Eldar]] and from the southern end of the [[Mountains of Mist]] to the [[Sea of Storms]]. It was bordered by [[Safer]] to the north, [[Manetheren]] to the northeast, and [[Eharon]] to the east. Its capital was [[Ancohima]]. Its other major cities were [[Condaris]], [[Mainelle]] (on the site of modern [[Tanchico]]), and [[Shar Honelle]]. All were [[Ogier]]-built.{{ref|{{twotc}}}}

Aelgar's territory incorporated most of modern [[Tarabon]], all of [[Amadicia]], and a thin slice of western [[Altara]], as well as the entirety of the [[Shadow Coast]].

==History==
Aelgar arose in the aftermath of the [[Breaking of the World]]. King [[Remedan|Remedan the Goldentongued]] signed the [[Compact of the Ten Nations]] for Aelgar in {{Ab|209}}, allying the kingdom to the other nations of the [[Westlands]].

Mat's earliest memory given to him by the [[Eelfinn]] is fighting against the Aelgari on the side of King [[Maecine]] of [[Eharon]] between 500-{{ab|600}}.{{ref/book|5|22}}

It was known for its "fabled lost mines" that lay south of modern-day Amadicia in the mountain range on the Shadow Coast.{{ref/book|11|p}}

It survived the Trolloc Wars, but collapsed shortly thereafter, with the nations of [[Balasun]] and [[Kharendor]] arising from its ruins.
